Bug_Title: RE: Invalid syntax for regular expression (RE_BAD_SYNTAX_FOR_REGULAR_EXPRESSION)
Bug_Details:
The code here uses a regular expression that is invalid according to the syntax
for regular expressions. This statement will throw a PatternSyntaxException when
executed.
Bug_Explanation: The bug was embedded by starting a character class '[a-zA-Z0-9\' without closing it. This will throw a PatternSyntaxException when the regular expression is compiled.
Trigger_Explanation: The test case 'testShowBug' calls the'showBug' method which contains an invalid regular expression. This causes a PatternSyntaxException to be thrown, triggering the bug.
